name: Eperisone
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Muscle tone improvement (neck-shoulder syndrome, low back pain) and spastic paralysis
usual_adult_dose.dose: 150 mg/day in 3 divided doses after meals; adjust for age and symptoms

key_interactions.effect: Eye accommodation disorder reported with the related drug tolperisone.

monitoring: Sedation and weakness; liver function in hepatic impairment

sources.citation: Myonal tablets 50 mg and granules 10% (eperisone hydrochloride) [Japanese package insert, 2nd edition, revised April 2025; drug-information contact: Kaken Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.]. (2025). Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA), Japan.

revision_log.change: Proteinuria/raised BUN added (verified in insert 11.2; frequency not determinable). MAH could not be confirmed, so the citation names no MAH (Kaken listed as drug-information contact only).
